lead.event: Singapore unveils a five-year energy plan with major grid investment
lead.headline: Singapore unveils five-year energy plan with up to S$5.3 billion for grid investment
lead.blurb: The Energy Market Authority’s plan includes seven new substations by 2031 and an 18 per cent expansion of the transmission cable network to 9,100 km by 2030. It also targets more than 1 gigawatt-hour of energy storage by 2030, trebling capacity from around 350 megawatt-hours. Grid spending from 2025 to 2029 is 11 times the preceding five-year period, as peak demand is projected to reach 9.9 to 13 GW by 2031, from 8.6 GW currently. Five new natural gas plants are scheduled to come online over the next five years.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: HSBC reports higher Q3 profit and announces a buyback and dividend
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: HSBC reports 32% higher Q3 profit and announces buyback and dividend
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Pretax profit reached US$9.6 billion for July-September, while wealth division revenue was flat at US$2.7 billion. HSBC announced an interim dividend of US$0.1 per share and a buyback of up to US$1 billion. The bank said it remains on track to meet its core profitability targets through 2028.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: SK Hynix announces a major shareholder-return plan after record profit
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: SK Hynix announces US$75 billion shareholder-return plan after record profit
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The 2026 plan comprises more than 30 trillion won in cash dividends and more than 60 trillion won in share repurchases and cancellations, including 40 trillion won announced in August. SK Hynix reported record July-September operating profit of 83.3 trillion won and will return most of its gain from Kioxia through a special dividend in its third-quarter and full-year payouts.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Sembcorp Green Infra prepares a potential IPO
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Sembcorp Green Infra prepares potential IPO to raise up to US$394 million
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Sembcorp Industries is meeting investors for a proposed IPO of its Indian renewable-energy subsidiary, involving a fresh issue worth up to 37.5 billion rupees. The listing could launch as early as December, pending regulatory approval, and its timing and size could change.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: UltraGreen.ai cuts FY2026 guidance and announces shareholder-return measures
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: UltraGreen.ai cuts FY2026 guidance and announces buyback of up to US$30 million
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: It expects full-year revenue below its previous US$175 million to US$185 million target as US competition intensifies, with 2027 revenue and profitability also under pressure. Its new policy calls for at least 30% of annual net profit, excluding special items, to be distributed semi-annually.

other.event: Zhuhai Huafa misses trust-product payments and seeks loan extensions
other.headline: Zhuhai Huafa misses trust payments and seeks bank extensions on RMB413 billion liabilities
other.blurb: The Guangdong government-owned group missed payments on two trust products and is seeking loan extensions from at least three banks. Its offshore yuan bond fell a record 17% to about 74% of face value, while shares of its real estate arm fell as much as 8.9% in Shanghai.

other.event: ST Engineering wins S$5.6 billion in Q3 contracts
other.headline: ST Engineering wins S$5.6 billion in Q3 contracts
other.blurb: The quarter's wins comprised S$1.4 billion from Commercial Aerospace, S$1.8 billion from Defence and Public Security, and S$2.4 billion from Urban Solutions and Satcom. The nine-month total reached S$13.2 billion, excluding a US$1.3 billion New Jersey Turnpike Authority contract that is included in the order book. ST Engineering said the contracts are not expected to materially affect net tangible assets per share or earnings per share for the current financial year.

other.event: Keppel RigCo and Seatrium collaborate on four offshore rigs
other.headline: Keppel RigCo and Seatrium collaborate on four rigs in S$500 million-plus contract
other.blurb: The package covers a seventh-generation drillship, a harsh-environment jackup and two semisubmersible rigs for harsh conditions in north-west Europe, funded from RigCo’s existing cash reserves. The drillship is due for delivery in 2027 and the jackup in 2028 for charters, while plans for the other two rigs are under evaluation.

other.event: Seatrium wins an FPSO integration contract from SBM Offshore
other.headline: Seatrium wins 200 million FPSO integration contract from SBM Offshore
other.blurb: The work includes integrating topside modules, modifying and drydocking the vessel, and fabricating support structures. Execution is expected to start in the fourth quarter of 2026, with completion scheduled for 2029.

market_structure_policy.event: Singapore’s haze investigation expands to plantation firms and regulatory follow-up
market_structure_policy.headline: Singapore expands haze investigation to 10 firms as Wilmar appoints investigators
market_structure_policy.blurb: The government plans an Act amendment at the next parliamentary sitting to penalise companies that refuse assessors or fail to cooperate. Wilmar will fund panel investigators and law firms to assess possible links to Indonesian fires, becoming the first locally listed palm oil and agriculture company to do so.

market_structure_policy.event: IMDA issues Simba a show-cause notice over spectrum misuse
market_structure_policy.headline: IMDA issues Simba show-cause notice over alleged spectrum misuse at about 133 sites
market_structure_policy.blurb: IMDA alleges misuse at about 133 sites and unauthorised use of another spectrum band at about 92 sites. It is considering suspending or cancelling Simba’s spectrum rights, shortening its licence and a fine of up to 10% of annual turnover or S$1 million, whichever is higher. Simba intends to respond by 16 November.

earnings_guidance.event: Wilmar returns to profit in Q3
earnings_guidance.headline: Wilmar returns to Q3 profit with US$281.03 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: A year-earlier US$347.70 million loss largely reflected a US$712.3 million compensation expense paid to the Indonesian government. Excluding that one-off, net profit fell 22.9% from US$364.6 million, while core net profit declined 25.2% to US$267.3 million.

earnings_guidance.event: DFI Retail reports Q3 growth and raises FY2026 earnings guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: DFI Retail reports 17% Q3 profit growth and lifts FY2026 guidance floor to US$295 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Continuing-operations sales rose 4%, with health and beauty up 7% and convenience stores up 5%. DFI kept the guidance ceiling at US$305 million, putting its US$300 million midpoint 2% above market consensus, and committed to raising its dividend payout ratio from 70% in FY2026 to 80% in FY2027.

earnings_guidance.event: iFAST reports higher Q3 profit and raises dividend guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: iFAST reports Q3 net profit up 24.5% and raises FY2026 dividend guidance
earnings_guidance.blurb: It proposed a third interim dividend of 3.2 cents per share, up 39.1%, and expects FY2026 dividends of at least 12 cents per share, versus 10.50 cents projected in April. Revenue rose 23% to S$167.01 million.

earnings_guidance.event: Standard Chartered reports higher Q3 profit and raises income guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: Standard Chartered reports US$2.25 billion Q3 pretax profit, lifts 2026 income guidance
earnings_guidance.blurb: The result topped the US$2.09 billion Bloomberg-compiled analyst average, driven by global trading and wealth. Chief executive Bill Winters said consistent performance gave the bank confidence to raise its income guidance.

deals_control.event: DFI Retail proposes taking over Maxim’s Starbucks franchise business
deals_control.headline: DFI Retail proposes taking over Maxim’s Starbucks franchise across 1,100 stores
deals_control.blurb: Under the proposed deal, DFI Retail Group will transfer all its Maxim’s Food shares to Maxim’s, which will pay approximately US$340 million in cash. The Starbucks business is expected to generate US$600-650 million in revenue in 2027 and about US$900 million in 2028.

deals_control.event: Yangzijiang Maritime sells six newbuild tankers
deals_control.headline: Yangzijiang Maritime signs US$308 million contracts to sell six newbuild tankers
deals_control.blurb: The buyer was not disclosed. Two tankers are about 49,500 DWT each and four are about 49,800 DWT each, with the four larger vessels due between 2027 and 2028. The sales are expected to contribute positively to results.

deals_control.event: OUE REIT acquires an additional Salesforce Tower stake
deals_control.headline: OUE REIT to acquire additional 50% Salesforce Tower stake for A$864 million
deals_control.blurb: The acquisition will take OUE REIT’s stake to 69.9% upon completion and will be funded through debt and partial net proceeds from the divestment of Crowne Plaza Changi Airport. OUE REIT bought an initial 19.9% interest on 16 March 2026, and the further acquisition is expected to generate 3.2% pro forma distribution per unit accretion for the six months ended 30 June 2026.

deals_control.event: URA awards Marina Gardens Lane site to EL Development
deals_control.headline: URA awards Marina Gardens Lane site to EL Development for S$450.1 million
deals_control.blurb: Its bid works out to S$1,243 per square foot per plot ratio for the 99-year leasehold site, which includes ground-floor commercial space and is expected to yield about 390 homes. EL Development was the sole bidder when the tender closed on 15 October, and URA announced the award on 26 October.
